label: Listening 1 — Five short dialogues
lines: Listening one. Listen to five short dialogues.
Good morning, Tom. You're early today!
Hi! I'm Katie. I'm new here.
Oh, hi, Katie! Nice to meet you. I'm Ben.
Nice to meet you too, Ben.
Hello, Mr Hill. How are you?
I'm fine, thank you. And you?
Good evening! Come in, welcome to the party.
Good evening! Thank you very much.

label: Listening 2 — Spell your name (5 people)
lines: Listening two. Spell your name. Listen and write the names.
Thanks, Emma. And what's your name?
Can you spell it for me?
Oh, hello! Are you the new teacher?
Yes, I am. I'm Mr Green.
Green. How do you spell that?
S. O. P. H. I. E.

label: Listening 3 — Numbers (5 people)
lines: Listening three. Listen and circle the right number.
Hi, I'm Tom, and I'm thirteen years old.
This is my grandmother. She's seventy-two, but she still plays tennis!
Hello, I'm Sara. My class is small. There are fifteen students in it.
My name's Ben. I take the bus to school. It's bus number forty-eight.
Our school is really big. We've got ninety computers!
